name: @postpin-io/resolve-plugin
description: PostPin workflow integration plugin for DaVinci Resolve

scripts.install:dev:mac: P="/Library/Application Support/Blackmagic Design/DaVinci Resolve/Workflow Integration Plugins" && node build.mjs --dev && sudo mkdir -p "$P" && sudo rm -rf "$P/com.postpin.resolve" && sudo cp -R dist "$P/com.postpin.resolve"
scripts.install:mac: P="/Library/Application Support/Blackmagic Design/DaVinci Resolve/Workflow Integration Plugins" && pnpm run build && sudo mkdir -p "$P" && sudo rm -rf "$P/com.postpin.resolve" && sudo cp -R dist "$P/com.postpin.resolve"
